answers.statement: Aircraft simulation design can be organized around an integrated conceptual-design and simulation-optimization environment that runs an end-to-end civil-airplane design case and uses an optimizer to minimize a design objective such as direct operating cost.
answers.scope: Applies when an integrated conceptual-design toolset and a simulation-integration optimizer are available for civil-airplane conceptual design.
answers.criteria: Evidence would include claims showing an end-to-end conceptual design system and an optimization environment minimizing a design objective within that workflow.

answers.statement: Conceptual aircraft design can be pursued through a unified modular multidisciplinary design optimization framework with nested optimization levels that optimize configuration and wing-box design variables, while structural and static-margin constraints may materially affect the resulting design.
answers.scope: Applies when a modular MDO framework and appropriate structural or static-margin constraints are available for conceptual aircraft design.
answers.criteria: Evidence would include a modular MDO framework with nested optimization levels and studies showing how structural or static-margin constraints change optimized designs.

answers.statement: Aircraft simulation can be formulated as a coupled nonlinear differential-algebraic flight-dynamics model with six-degree-of-freedom equations expressed in body or wind axes, requiring state variables and parameters to be specified.
answers.scope: Applies when a physics-based flight-dynamics model is needed and the equation structure, axis system, variables, and parameters can be specified.
answers.criteria: Evidence would include claims specifying the DAE structure, axis-system equations, and variable or parameter requirements for flight-dynamics simulation.

answers.statement: Simulation-model fidelity can be improved by identifying aerodynamic delta or parameter models from flight-test or simulated doublet data and updating the original aerodynamic database, followed by checking predictions against measured flight parameters.
answers.scope: Applies when test or simulated maneuver data are available for identifying aerodynamic increments or parameters and updating an existing simulation model.
answers.criteria: Evidence would include identification of aerodynamic increments or parameters from test data and reported improvement of simulation predictions after updating the model.

answers.statement: Before flight test, aircraft simulation design can be validated through real-time hardware-in-the-loop testing in which a ground computer solves the aircraft dynamics and the integrated control and propulsion systems are exercised under specified tracking-error criteria.
answers.scope: Applies when a real-time HIL test platform and integrated control or propulsion components are available for pre-flight evaluation.
answers.criteria: Evidence would include a real-time HIL system computing aircraft dynamics, integrated control or propulsion operation, and reported tracking or stability results supporting pre-flight evaluation.
